snippet.title: Frostpunk 2: Fractured Utopias | Date Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now: https://re.11bits.com/hge
Last Chance to get The World of Frostpunk: Artbook & Anthology Exclusive Books Set - https://pledgemanager.11bitstudios.com/ 

Fractured Utopias launches on December 8 for both PC and console versions of #Frostpunk 2.

Every faction dreams of a perfect future, but only one vision can survive the frost. Build your utopia… or watch it shatter.
